name: Excel MCP Server
summary: An MCP server that lets AI clients create, read and edit Excel files, including charts, PivotTables and formulas, without Microsoft Excel.
use_cases: have an AI assistant create Excel charts
trace why a spreadsheet formula gives a wrong number
import a CSV file into an Excel sheet
features: create Excel charts including 2016 chart types
apply conditional formatting and data validation

capabilities.label: Create, read and edit Excel files via AI
Sort, filter, find and replace data
Format cells, fonts, borders, number formats
Serve over stdio or Streamable HTTP
Manage sheets: create, rename, copy, delete

manual_steps: Choose the folder the server may access (replace /path/to/workbooks)

steps.purpose: uv tool install excel-mcp-server (puts excel-mcp-server on PATH)

manual_steps: Choose the folder the server may access (replace /path/to/workbooks)

steps.purpose: uv tool install excel-mcp-server (puts excel-mcp-server on PATH)

setup.command:
mkdir -p /home/sbx/work/wb && ~/.local/share/uv/tools/excel-mcp-server/bin/python - <<'EOF'
from openpyxl import Workbook
wb=Workbook(); ws=wb.active; ws.title="Sales"
rows=[("Region","Product","Units","Price","Revenue"),("North","Apple",10,2,None),("South","Apple",5,2,None),("North","Pear",7,3,None),("South","Pear",4,3,None)]
for r in rows: ws.append(r)
for i in range(2,6): ws[f"E{i}"]=f"=C{i}*D{i}"
ws["E7"]="=SUM(E2:E5)"
ws["F7"]="=E7*1.1"
wb.save("/home/sbx/work/wb/sales.xlsx")
print("ok")
EOF

pitfalls.readme_said: Every client runs the server with `uvx excel-mcp-server stdio`
pitfalls.actually_needed: `uv tool install excel-mcp-server` then `excel-mcp-server stdio --allow-dir DIR`, so the server also starts later without network

pitfalls.readme_said: create_pivot_table value_fields described as headers to summarize
pitfalls.actually_needed: value_fields needs objects such as [{"field":"Units","function":"sum"}], and the target sheet must already exist; my first call, with plain strings and a new sheet name, returned an error (cmd 7)

pitfalls.readme_said: add_slicer adds slicers for tables and PivotTables
pitfalls.actually_needed: target must be an object {"sheet":...,"name":...}, not a bare PivotTable name (cmd 12 failed, cmd 15 worked)

judge.observed: All three probes exit 0: handshake ok with 46 tools listed, read_range returned values for E2:F7, and trace_formula returned precedents C2:E5.

lets
Claude, Cursor, VS Code Copilot, Codex and other AI clients create, read and edit Excel files:

install_per_os.quote: claude mcp add excel --scope user -- uvx excel-mcp-server stdio --allow-dir /path/to/workbooks

config_and_keys.quote: | `--allow-dir DIR` | `EXCEL_FILES_PATH` | none (stdio), `./excel_files` (HTTP) | Folders workbooks must be in |

troubleshooting_uninstall.quote:
Desktop apps often cannot find `uvx`, because they do not see your shell's `PATH` (common
on macOS). Use its full path instead, which `which uvx` prints.

license_and_platforms.quote:
It is built on `openpyxl`, needs **no Microsoft
Excel**, and runs on Windows, macOS and Linux.
